resources.string: Wallhaven API key (optional, required for NSFW)
Pexafy requires an API key. It stays inactive until you save and enable it.
Select Wallhaven or Openverse above before removing the key. Your current key remains saved until you confirm removal.
Changes take effect only when saved.
A saved key is not a validity check. Credential, quota, and connection errors are reported when Pexafy is used.
